描述_EN: he has a camera lens for an eye, the olympic rings as bracelets, and a taxi light on top of his head. wenlock and paralympic mascot mandeville were designed by london-based company iris, and inspired by a short story by children’s author michael morpurgo which told how they were formed by drops of steel in the production of the olympic stadium. wenlock is the official olympic mascot for london 2012. aimed at children to promote london 2012, the mascots star in their own short film, have a social media presence and appear on a wide range of merchandise. the name comes from much wenlock, the town in shropshire that inspired the modern olympic games.
描述_ZN: 他的眼睛有一个相机镜头，奥运五环是手镯，他的头顶上有一个出租车灯。 温洛克和残奥会吉祥物曼德维尔是由总部设在伦敦的IRIS公司设计的，其灵感来自于儿童文学作家迈克尔-莫普戈的一个短篇故事，故事讲述了他们是如何在奥林匹克体育场的生产过程中由钢滴形成的。 温洛克是2012年伦敦奥运会的官方吉祥物。 以儿童为目标来宣传2012年伦敦奥运会，吉祥物在他们自己的短片中出演，在社交媒体上出现，并出现在各种商品上。 这个名字来自于多温洛克，这个位于什罗普郡的小镇激发了现代奥林匹克运动会。
